snippet.title: Actions & Stuff: Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Here: https://orevillestudios.com/content/actions-&-stuff/resource-pack
Join Community: https://orevillestudios.com/discord

The Animation Pack You Didn't Know You Needed: Bring your world to life with new animations, particles, textures, and more! Actions & Stuff is an animation and texture overhaul for Minecraft Bedrock that stays true to the vanilla style.

- Player Animations (1st Person & 3rd Person)
- Mob Animations (For every mob)
- Particles & Effects (Explosions, visual effects, glowing eyes, etc)
- Vanilla Inspired Texture Pack (You can also play with Vanilla Textures or Custom Textures)
- Works with your own Skin, Character Creator Items, and Capes
- 3D Items, Armour & Custom Beds
- Improved ambiance with Custom Fog & Sky Colours
- New Sounds
- Placeable Props, and Hats for your player character
- Easter Eggs & Secrets
- So much more!

More information: https://orevillestudios.com/actions-&-stuff

Gameplay footage: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ilEpCcj48Bk

Follow Oreville Studios to stay up to date! Join our community on Discord to give feedback, and receive support, or reach out to us via email.

X: https://x.com/orevillestudios
Discord: https://orevillestudios.com/discord
Support: support@orevillestudios.com
